headline: Belgium leads US 2-1 at halftime after Charles De Ketelaere's brace in Seattle
summary: Charles De Ketelaere scored two goals for Belgium, while Malik Tillman netted a stunning free-kick for the US, setting up a tense second half.
details: Belgium has taken a 2-1 lead against the United States at halftime in Seattle, fueled by two impressive goals from forward Charles De Ketelaere. The match has been marked by early drama, including the controversial inclusion of US player Folarin Balogun.
The game saw Belgium strike first in just the 9th minute. Capitalizing on a defensive lapse, Charles De Ketelaere calmly finished inside the box to put his team ahead 1-0.
The US responded in the 31st minute when midfielder Malik Tillman scored a spectacular free-kick. His powerful shot from outside the box leveled the score at 1-1, igniting the home crowd.
However, the American celebration was short-lived. Just two minutes later, in the 33rd minute, De Ketelaere struck again, converting an attack from midfield to restore Belgium's lead at 2-1.
The quick succession of goals left the US defense in disarray. Despite pre-match controversies, Belgium's sharp play on the pitch has put them in a strong position as the second half approaches.
caption:
Belgium leads the United States 2-1 at halftime in a dramatic football match in Seattle. Charles De Ketelaere scored two goals for Belgium.

Belgium has taken a 2-1 lead against the United States at halftime in Seattle, fueled by two impressive goals from forward Charles De Ketelaere. The match has been marked by early drama, including the controversial inclusion of US player Folarin Balogun.

The game saw Belgium strike first in just the 9th minute. Capitalizing on a defensive lapse, Charles De Ketelaere calmly finished inside the box to put his team ahead 1-0.

The US responded in the 31st minute when midfielder Malik Tillman scored a spectacular free-kick. His powerful shot from outside the box leveled the score at 1-1, igniting the home crowd.

However, the American celebration was short-lived. Just two minutes later, in the 33rd minute, De Ketelaere struck again, converting an attack from midfield to restore Belgium's lead at 2-1.

The quick succession of goals left the US defense in disarray. Despite pre-match controversies, Belgium's sharp play on the pitch has put them in a strong position as the second half approaches.
